title: Telemetry Credits + Compliance Bundle Pilot for Enterprise Contracts
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Summary: Run a pilot that packages three enterprise add-ons together (Telemetry Credits for extended observability retention, a Compliance Bundle with pre-filled security questionnaire artifacts & signed addendum, and an optional Premium SLA) and A/B test commercial and gating models. Goal is to validate willingness-to-pay, conversion lift for self-serve vs sales-assisted customers, and friction in contract/security review cycles.

Background: Enterprise customers frequently ask for longer observability retention and artifact evidence for security questionnaires during procurement. Current offerings expose retention tiers and separate legal attachments; sales reports multiple coordination delays between Product, Security, and Legal when preparing RfIs. This experiment ties a consumable "Telemetry Credits" model (credits buy extra retention) with a pre-scoped Compliance Bundle to reduce review cycles, and an opt-in Premium SLA with clear SLOs and pricing.

Hypotheses: 
1) Packaging observability retention as finite credits (rather than permanent tier upsells) lowers onboarding friction and shows stronger initial conversion for mid-market customers.
2) Including a Compliance Bundle (prepopulated answers, artifact links, signed addendum) will reduce security-questionnaire turnaround by >= 30% for customers in pilot.
3) Offering Premium SLA as an add-on at point-of-contract (with defined remedy terms and optional Dedicated routing) will increase committed ARR per customer for those with >$50k ARR appetite.

Experiment variants: 
- Variant A (Control): Current model - retention tiers selectable in Console + manual Legal addendum negotiation.
- Variant B (Telemetry Credits + Compliance Lite): Telemetry Credits sold in 30/90/365-day packs; Compliance Lite includes prefilled questionnaire + artifact bundle, self-serve download. No SLA.
- Variant C (Full Bundle): Telemetry Credits + Compliance Bundle (signed addendum templated for quick e-sign) + optional Premium SLA quoted during contract. Sales-assisted onboarding only.

Scope and constraints: Pilot limited to 20 prospective customers (mix of inbound trials flagged by AE as mid-market and 10 outbound prospects). Billing integration must surface credits consumption on invoices (requires billing schema change led by ENG-4321). Compliance artifacts must be stable and approved by Security & Legal before pilot (see notes). Premium SLA requires guidance from Reliability and Dedicated teams on routing/fallback language and pricing floors.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry Credits productized in billing with 30/90/365 packs available in Console and purchasable via sales quote.
Compliance Bundle contents (SOC excerpts, encryption diagrams, data flow, control owner contacts) approved by Security & Legal and packaged as a downloadable artifact.
Pilot enrollment flow completed for at least 12 customers and telemetry retention extended for enrolled accounts.
Measurement dashboard created showing questionnaire turnaround time, add-on attach rate, ARR delta for customers in each variant.
Premium SLA contract addendum drafted and reviewed by Legal; remediation and credit calculations defined and signed off by Reliability.
Post-pilot recommendation with pricing bands and gating rules delivered to GTM and Platform teams.
rollout_plan: Week 0-1: Finalize bundle contents, Legal/Security sign-off, billing contract for credits. Week 2: Implement Console flows for purchasing and credits consumption (small UI path), instrument analytics. Week 3-6: Enroll pilot customers, run sales-assisted onboarding for Variant C, collect metrics. Week 7: Analyze results, hold cross-functional readout, and produce RFC for general availability or iterate on pricing. Contingency: If billing changes delayed, run pilot with manual invoicing and track usage in a side table (requires AE time).
metrics: Primary: attach rate (add-ons purchased) per eligible deal
Secondary: incremental ARR from pilot customers after 90 days
Secondary: telemetry credits burn rate and retention cost delta
Secondary: CSAT for procurement process (post-onboarding survey)
notes: Security checklist (must be green before enrolment): encryption-at-rest, KMS key ownership options, audit-log access patterns
Sales playbook stub saved in Notion under 'Enterprise Add-ons > Telemetry Credits'
